label: JXCT JXBS-3001-NPK-RS ×4 — soil 7-in-1 via Dragino (Modbus→MQTT)
notes: Four JXCT seven-in-one soil probes on one RS485 bus → Dragino RS485-NB. Configure each probe to a unique Modbus address (holding reg 0x0100): slave 1, 2, 3, 4. Wire all A/B to Dragino RS485; power each probe 5–24 VDC. Tags: S1_SOIL_PH … S4_K_MG_KG (28 points). Cloud: POST /api/parc/dragino-gateway/bind-preset with presetId jxct_npk_jxbs3001_dragino_x4, then /plan — four AT+COMMAND lines (FC03 ×27 regs per slave) + AT+TDC=300. Single sensor: use jxct_npk_jxbs3001_dragino.
